PMAT-3471 (ONT-2b: Σ — contracts/ontology.yaml with entity_types and extractors; symbol-level check on formal:) audit complete.

All ticket requirements, acceptance criteria, and receipt claims were read and independently verified:
1. Σ schema & declaration (contracts/ontology.yaml): Declares 9 concepts, 6 roles, 66 symbols (operators/functions/predicates/constants), 1 world, 3 agents, 7 entity types mapped to declared extractors, 7 extractors, 3 not_expressible keys, and a complete readers mapping covering all populated keys.
2. Loader and malformed-Σ handling (crates/aprender-contracts/src/ontology/sigma.rs): Deserializes contracts/ontology.yaml and enforces the 4 malformed-Σ classes via Sigma::check_integrity, returning typed SigmaError mapped to exit code 3 (error:). 10/10 unit tests pass.
3. Sigma gate & symbol check (crates/aprender-contracts/src/lint/sigma_gate.rs, sigma_symbols.rs): Evaluates raw YAML to check PV-ONT-001 (entity.type in Σ), PV-ONT-002 (relations in Σ roles), PV-ONT-003 (operator glyphs in Σ or explicit prose: true), and PV-ONT-004 (shrink-only formal_prose ratchet). Symbol check restricts to operator glyphs while leaving applied identifiers to ONT-3a. 15/15 unit tests pass.
4. CLI --gate mode & ONT-6 lattice (crates/aprender-contracts-cli/): pv lint --gate <name> executes single gates and outputs SingleGateReport with accurate exit codes (0 for Pass, 1 for corpus reject, 2 for decline/no-sigma, 3 for malformed Σ). 8/8 CLI integration tests pass.
5. Gate arming & baseline (contracts/lint-baseline.json): Armed gates count increased monotonically from 8 to 9 with sigma armed. formal_prose baseline set at measured 1464. Full pv lint contracts/ passes cleanly across all 9 armed gates.
6. Real corpus verification & quality gates: ontology.yaml added to NON_CONTRACT_FILENAMES, census updated to 1793, ont-sigma-v1.yaml validated, clippy clean with -D warnings.

No refutations found. Verdict is PASS.
